title: Arithmetic Steps
user: An elementary teacher or parent who wants children to see and manipulate the intermediate structure of arithmetic rather than memorize answer snapshots.
smallest_useful_product: Offline web game for addition/subtraction to 100: manipulate counters and ten-frames, narrate each transformation, replay an attempt, and generate a discussion card.
constraints: Accessible color and non-drag input alternatives

Sandbox-verifiable pedagogy rules: children choose chunks, each step has an accurate equation and sentence, finished routes replay with discussion prompts, and the self-guided checklist stores no marks or learning-outcome claim
